Nora (CS): quick heads-up — Vortex preview (wave K) can’t finish invites; their IdP returns "invalid-issuer". PM says procurement deadline in 12 days; AM marked renewal as 'watch'.
Hector (Enablement): we can run a 20m "fast unblock" to get product folks running core flows while infra sorts IdP. offer temp access + micro-feedback.
Pri (SolutionsEng): 20m works. need their IdP metadata + the full SAML request/response payload. asked yesterday, no reply.
Nora (CS): i'll nudge the PM now and propose two mitigation options: 1) scoped temp token (audited, auto-revoke), 2) proxy-harness (timebound). which do we prefer?
Pri (SolutionsEng): temp token is fastest. proxy-harness ok if legal needs explicit wording. token should be scoped for "staging" only with audit trail and 14-day TTL.
Aly (AM): legal prefers the standard pilot addendum for harnesses, but temp tokens used before are fine with a quick addendum. i'll prep a one-paragraph note for procurement. :memo:
onboard-bot: Temp token prepared: https://redwood.example/tokens/vortex-temp-77 - expires 2024-12-20T08:00Z. Audit logging enabled.
Hector (Enablement): i'll make a 1-slide quickstart: endpoints, sample curl, env vars, and a 1-question pulse: "Did you validate your top-3 flows? yes/no". We'll push result to CRM tag vortex-wavek.
Pri (SolutionsEng): i'll attach a rollback play: revoke token -> reprovision sandbox -> rotate keys. also include a recommended staging model (tiny-llm-q2) to keep latency down during tests.
Nora (CS): onboard-bot, please schedule a 20m invite for Mon 2024-12-02 17:00 UTC — attendees: Nora (CS), Hector (Enablement), Pri (SolutionsEng), Vortex PM, Aly (AM).
onboard-bot: Calendar invite created: Mon 2024-12-02 17:00-17:20 UTC - "Vortex wave K: fast unblock (20m)" - join: https://meet.redwood/example/vortexk
Hector (Enablement): agenda: 1) quick IdP triage (5m), 2) temp token walkthrough + sample curl (8m), 3) run 3 core flows + pulse (7m). cap at 20m.
Aly (AM): i'll draft the procurement note and attach the pilot addendum template just in case. will ping legal for a 1-hour turnaround.
Pri (SolutionsEng): small ask — can CS surface any prior Vortex feedback? they mentioned token expiry quirks on long-running streams. might need keepalive guidance.
Nora (CS): i pulled a short note earlier, will paste here after i DM the PM.
Hector (Enablement): during demo i'll show a quick pattern for pinning a smaller model and enabling prefix caching to reduce token usage.
Nora (CS): next steps: 1) Nora nudge PM for SAML payload + any screenshots (ASAP). 2) Hector prep invite + pulse + quickstart (Tue EOD). 3) Pri prepare rollback + model note (Tue EOD). 4) Aly prepare procurement blurb & pilot addendum (Tue EOD).
Pri (SolutionsEng): ack.
Hector (Enablement): ack.
Nora (CS): thanks everyone. ping here when PM uploads artifacts and i'll forward to AM. :thumbsup:
onboard-bot: Reminder scheduled: 24h before session — send join link and pulse.
